title: Policy-based access control
steps: 16 page requests by customer / staff / admin + staff DELETE /products/LPA-001
expected: Each user group reaches only the pages its permissions allow (403 otherwise); every refusal logged as ACCESS_DENIED
actual: 16/16 as expected; staff delete -> 403; 10 ACCESS_DENIED events

title: Deny by default
steps: Ask the policy engine for an unknown permission, for an inactive administrator, and with no user
expected: All three refused; policy file says defaultDecision "deny"
actual: unknown permission -> false; inactive admin -> false; no user -> false; 20 permissions x 3 groups, default deny

title: Ownership: own orders and own reviews only
steps: Customer opens another client's invoice (INV-1001) and edits another client's review
expected: Both answered "not found" (404) - the data is not shown or changed
actual: order -> 404; edit review -> 404; review unchanged = true

title: Brute-force protection (lockout)
steps: 5 wrong passwords for mchang, then the RIGHT password; same for a user name that does not exist; then the 15-minute window passes
expected: 6th attempt refused even with the right password ("Too many failed sign-ins"); same answer for the unknown user; LOGIN_LOCKED logged; IP stored only as a hash; sign-in works after the window
actual: 5 wrong -> error=2; right password -> /login?error=3&m=15; unknown user 6th -> /login?error=3&m=15; logged = true; keys ip:12ca17b49, user:mchang, user:no-such; after window -> /

title: Wrong user name takes as long as wrong password
steps: Time 4 failed sign-ins for a real user and 4 for unknown user names
expected: Similar times (the password is checked against a dummy hash for unknown users), so attackers cannot find valid user names
actual: real user median 60 ms; unknown user median 62 ms

title: Password rules and changing your password
steps: Register with "Password1" and with the user name in the password; change password with a wrong current password, then correctly
expected: Common / user-name passwords refused; wrong current password refused; after the change the OTHER session is signed out, this one stays; only the new password works
actual: common -> 400 true; contains user name -> 400 true; wrong current -> 400; change -> 302; other session -> 302; this session -> 200; new password -> /shop; old password -> /login?error=2

title: Client phone numbers encrypted in MySQL
steps: Read lpa_clients.lpa_client_phone directly; open Clients; search by phone; encrypt the same number twice; change one character of a ciphertext
expected: Database holds only AES-256-GCM ciphertext; the page shows the real number; exact phone search works (blind index); same number -> different ciphertext (random IV); changed ciphertext rejected
actual: stored "v1.MGDs-zU9A_lz4LpL.Dz4tIl..." (digits visible = false); page shows number = true; phone search finds CL-004 = true; two ciphertexts differ = true; index = HMAC (true); tampered -> rejected

title: Injection protection
steps: JSON login with {"$ne":""}; JSON with __proto__; query ?q[$ne]=x; client search for ' OR '1'='1' --
expected: $-operators and __proto__ refused (400, logged as SECURITY); nested query values are not parsed into objects; SQL text treated as a plain value (no clients found)
actual: $ne -> 400; __proto__ -> 400; ?q[$ne] -> 200 (8 items, plain list); SQL -> 0 clients; SECURITY events 2

title: Code-access security (npm run start:secure)
steps: Start the app under the permission policy, sign in and use it; run a hostile script under the same policy
expected: App works normally; Security page reports the policy enforced; reading system files, changing the code and running programs are denied
actual: sign-in true; /products 200; sandbox enabled true, ok true; probe: read /etc/passwd: ERR_ACCESS_DENIED; change server.js: ERR_ACCESS_DENIED; run a program: ERR_ACCESS_DENIED; read .env: ALLOWED

title: Encryption in transit (HTTPS)
steps: Start the app with a certificate; sign in over HTTPS; try plain HTTP on the same port
expected: TLS 1.2 or 1.3; HSTS header; session cookie marked Secure; plain HTTP not answered
actual: TLSv1.3; HSTS "max-age=15552000"; cookie Secure = true; plain HTTP refused

title: Second application secured: LPA Android app
steps: Check the Android manifest, network security config, WebView code and release build settings
